description: Turku: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Turku. Coverage: Turku. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Turun ja Kaarinan kantakartan sähköverkon osat; Turun ja Kaarinan ajokieltoalueet sähköpotkulaudoille; Turun ja Kaarinan nopeusrajoitusalueet sähköpotkulaudoille. Formats seen: OGC API, WFS, KUNTAGML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
